text_block_list.text:
It's one of those cold and windy
December days
where you can see your
breath hanging wispily in
the air in front
of you.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, I receive an invitation
from Air
Groove requesting a meeting in
my office.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wondering what she wants, I hurry over
to find...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My office has been completely
transformed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Happy Holidays!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That flabbergasted look tells me
you've
forgotten what day it is.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It's true that I'm taken aback—not least
because
of Эйр Грув's sudden joyous
cheer—but also...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yes, this morning. It's not perfect, but I
believe
this should suffice.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I didn't just decorate. I've also prepared
dinner
and a cake.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Tis the season, after all. It doesn't feel
right to let
this time of year pass without
a proper
celebration.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: I feel bad you had to do all this by yourself.

text_block_list.text:
Spare me your sympathy. I did this of my
own
volition.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Besides, I thought it would be a good
opportunity
to celebrate all of our hard
work.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It occurred to me that we hadn't
properly
commemorated any of our
victories thus far.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I thought we could reflect on the year
and be
proud of what we've
accomplished.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That seems more our style, wouldn't you
agree?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
So consider this a victory party and
holiday
festivity in one—and don't you
dare think about
doing any more work
today.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Before we start, there's something very
important
I'm still waiting to hear from
you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Surely you know what it is?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Very good.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Again, Happy Holidays to you too.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
As we feast, Эйр Грув and I reflect on
the past
year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As we feast, Эйр Грув and I reflect on
the past
year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We're having so much fun that time is
flying by.
Just as our merriment is
reaching its peak...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is for you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
A token of my appreciation for all of
your hard
work. And of course, it's also a
present befitting
the season.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: By all means.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I unwrap the package to find a
leather-bound
planner inside.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you like it. I picked it out just
for you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Open it to the calendar pages.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I open the planner to find a huge
number of
important details already
penned in on many of
the dates inside.
From holidays to scheduled
races—it's
all there.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You seem incapable of remembering
these things,
so I thought it would help
you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I hope you can put it to good use and
keep up
the good work in the coming
year.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I can use this planner to ensure
that next
year will be a very productive
one for the both of
us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We spend the rest of the evening
together,
enveloped by warm feelings
and plentiful mirth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Looking back, it was quite a fulfilling
one. I'm
happy we have the chance to sit
down and look
back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
